title: bank of england / bank rate / rate decision | Rate Decision | Interest rates and Bank Rate: our latest decision
summary: The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee held Bank Rate at 3.75% on 19 March 2026, marking the sixth consecutive hold following six cuts since August 2024. The committee cited the Middle East war as a driver of higher energy prices, which will push inflation above prior expectations in the near term. Current inflation stands at 3% against a 2% target.
